facts.business: Inox Wind Limited is a renewable energy company engaged in manufacturing wind turbine generators and providing turnkey wind power solutions as part of the INOXGFL Group.
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables includes Rs 34,542.22 lakhs (previous year Rs 49,303.65 lakhs) related to other related parties. Inter-corporate deposits from subsidiary of Rs 7,655.34 lakhs (previous year Rs 6,052.22 lakhs) are unsecured, repayable on demand and carry interest rate in the range of 7% to 12%. Other payables to related party of Rs 4,847.19 lakhs in previous year.
